column3: The CORS checks evaluate the response of the in-process ASGI app to BootUI's fixed preflight (origin https://evil.example, request method GET), not a loopback HTTP response; the report labels it heuristic synthetic evidence and does not claim browser, proxy or deployed-edge behaviour. The PT-A05-069 recommendation keeps the A10 wording because no loopback listener exists. Reason: no socket may be opened (consistent with pentesting:transport).

The A02 coverage descriptions are BootUI's wording with the Spring and Quarkus sentences replaced by "Servlet mappings and servlet-security evidence are unavailable on this adapter." and "Route authorization and Actuator configuration are not assessed by this adapter."; statuses and precedence are BootUI's (a finding gives REVIEW, incomplete evidence gives INDETERMINATE, otherwise INFO). Reason: the Python ASGI adapter has neither framework.

A fixed limitation names PT-A05-073 as indeterminate when either of its probe halves is withheld; BootUI's PT-A05-069 text omits it. Reason: fail closed, at no parity cost; the 069 finding text is BootUI's.

Host-echoed fragments in CORS evidence (an origin, a header token) are masked one by one before the 240-character cut and become [masked] under METADATA_ONLY; BootUI does not mask evidence. Fixed text is never masked. Reason: secrets are masked before any output.
A10 is not INDETERMINATE on a truncated GET header inventory (BootUI: getFailed || getBodyTruncated || optionsFailed). Reason: outside lane A11.

A GET-incomplete result overrides an A10 finding in coverage; BootUI checks findings first. The finding stays in the report; only the coverage label is more cautious (PT-A10-001 from an OPTIONS 5xx with a truncated GET 404 reports INDETERMINATE where BootUI reports REVIEW). A complete GET 5xx that fires PT-A10-001 is INDETERMINATE through the separate no-disclosure clause. Reason: outside lane A11; the OPTIONS input added by A11 follows BootUI's order.
A04, A10 and A03 report REVIEW where BootUI reports INFO; A02 follows BootUI. Reason: outside lane A11.
Starlette CORSMiddleware never sends Access-Control-Allow-Methods: *; PT-A05-023 reports only hosts that send the literal wildcard. Reason: framework behaviour; the check is ported as is.
